caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object composed primarily of three main sections: an upper section shaped like a bird with an elongated beak and tail, a middle vertical rod, and a lower section resembling a C-clamp with a threaded screw and an oval handle at the bottom. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray, indicating that it is a pencil or graphite drawing on a light beige background. The bird-like upper section consists of two curved, overlapping pieces that form the wings and body, with a small protrusion at the top suggesting a head or a fastening part. The middle rod connects the bird-shaped section to the C-clamp below. The clamp is depicted with a horizontal bar and a threaded vertical screw, ending in a closed oval handle. The drawing is contained within a rectangular border and signed in the lower left corner with a hand-written inscription. There are faint marks and spots on the background, likely due to age or imperfections in the paper.
title: Sewing Bird
